content: Godaas Dummatiza Gisha

« ‹Biitta intte laattanaas saaman shaakkiza wode, he biittafe issi saamaa GODAAS dummasidi woththite. Hessika tammanne nam7u kilo metirenne bagga aduqqizanne tammu kilo metire aakkiza soho gido. He sohoy mulekka geeshshasoho gido.
He sohoppe adussateththay 500 wadha, aahoteththaykka 500 wadha gidida oyddu gulay dizay Xoossa Keeththas gido; iza yuushon ichchash tammu wadha gidida doya sohoy deyo.

He GODAAS dummatida sohoppe adussateththay tammanne nam7u kilo metirenne bagga, aahoteththay qasse ichchash kilo metire gidida soho wadhdhada shaakka. He sohoy ubbaafe aadhdhida geeshsha sohoy Xoossa Keeththas gido.
Hessi Xoossa Keeththa giddon GODAAS ooththanaas, izakko shiiqiza qeesetas dummatida geeshshasoho gido; qasse istti bantta keeththa keexxiza sohonne Xoossa Keeththaska geeshshasoho gido.
Qasse attiza tammanne nam7u kilo metire bagga aduqqizanne ichchash kilo metire bagga aakkiza sohoy Xoossa Keeththan ooththiza Lewetas laata gido; istti baas de7iza katamata hessan keexxetto.
« ‹He GODAAS dummatida sohoza millen tammanne nam7u kilo metirenne bagga aduqqizanne nam7u kilo metirenne bagga aakkiza sohoy katama keexxanaas de7o; he sohoy Isra7eele asaas ubbaas gido.
Isra7eele Halaqas Imettida Gisha

« ‹Isra7eele halaqas imettida gishay nam7u baggarakka GODAAS dummatida sohoninne katama sohon zawatees. Izi arshe geloso baggara Mediteraane Abba gakkees; arshe kessa baggara biidi Isra7eele biitta zawa gakkees; izas adussateththayka issi qommos imettiza xinxxo gina gidees.
He gishay Isra7eele biitta halaqas laata gade gido. Hayssafe sinththan ta halaqati ta asa waayisoppetto; istti Isra7eele asay ubbay ba zaren zaren gade ekkana mala ooththetto.
Halaqas Imettida Woga

« ‹Ubbaa Haariza GODAY: Intteno Isra7eele halaqatoo, inttes ha7i gidana! Intte shabarssizayssanne asaa un7eththizayssa aggite; suure pirdanne xilloteth ooththite. Ta asa istta laata biittafe dhoqallidi gooddizayssa aggite. Tani Ubbaa Haariza GODAY hayssa yootays.
Intte ubbaasikka likke geeddaraynne maka miishshi de7o.

Inttes maka miishshas giddo gidiza Homeere geetettiza maka miish de7o; issi badoosey homeeres tammaafe issi kushe gidishin, issi efey homeeres tammaafe issi kushe gidees. Homeerey nam7u geeddaratasika erettida maka geeddara miish gido.
Issi saqiley nam7u tammu geera gidees; nam7u tammu saqile bolla nam7u tammanne ichchash saqile qasseka tammanne ichchash saqile gujjishin issi minaane gidees.
« ‹Intte imota immishe hayssa mala histti immite. Intte bukki shiishshiza gisttefe usuppun tammaafe issi kushe, banggafe usuppun tammaafe issi kushe,
qasse wogara zayteppe xeetappe issi kushe immite. Hayta meezaaniza wode, neni makkiza miishshay baate gido. Tammu baatey issi homeere woykko issi koore gidees.

Isra7eele asay heemmiza nam7u nam7u xeetu mehey diza issi wudeppe issi issi mehe immite. Heyti asa nagara atto giissanaas kaththa yarsho, xuugettiza yarshonne issifeteththa yarsho gidetto. Tani Ubbaa Haariza GODAY hayssa yootays.
Biittan diza asay ubbay hayssa ubbaa Isra7eele halaqas immo.

Halaqazi Isra7eele asay bonchchiza ba7aaletan, aginay xeeriza gallassataninne Sambatatan xuuggiza yarshota, kaththa yarshotanne ushsha yarshota shiishshi immo. Isra7eele asa nagara atto giissanaas, nagara yarshota, kaththa yarshota, xuugettiza yarshotanne issifeteththa yarshota ubbaa izi shiishshi immo.
« ‹Ubbaa Haariza GODAY: koyro aginan, koyro gallas borey baynda diza issi wofano Xoossa Keeththa geeshshanaas shiishsha.
Qeesey ha nagara yarsho suuththafe ekkidi, Xoossa Keeththa penge qosilaththata, yarshizaso yuushon diza oyddu zoozetanne giddo dabaaba efiza dirsa penge qosilaththata tiyo.
Oonikka qoppontta woykko erontta aggidi ooththida nagara atto giissanaas, aginaas laappunththa gallassan hessa malankka ooththa. Histtada Xoossa Keeththa tunateththafe geeshsha.
« ‹Koyro aginan, tammanne oydanththo gallassan Paaziga Ba7aale bonchchite; qasse laappun gallas gakkanaas irshoy gelontta uketh miite.
He koyro gallassan halaqay ba gishshassinne ba asaa gishshas nagara yarsho ooththidi issi wofano shiishshi immo.

He ba7aaley bonchchettiza laappun gallassatan hach hach laappun wofanotanne laappun dharshota ubbayka borey baynda bollara dizayta xuugettiza yarsho ooththidi, GODAAS shiishsho. Hessarakka issife nagara yarshos hach hach issi deysha orge shiishshi immo.
Issi issi wofanonne issi issi dharsho yarshiza wode, kaththa yarshos tammanne laappun kilo giraame gisttenne heedzdzu heedzdzu litiro zayte shiishshi immo.

« ‹Laappunththa aginan, tammanne ichchashanththa gallassan doommiza laappun gallas ba7aale woden ubbaan, nagara yarsho, xuugettiza yarsho, kaththa yarshonne zayte kaseyssafe dummasontta halaqay shiishshi immo.

footnotes.text: Issi homeerey nam7u xeetanne nam7u tammu kilo giraame woykko nam7u xeetanne nam7u tammu litiro gidees.
Issi saqiley tammanne issi giraamenne bagga deexxees.
